title: A Folk Legend, ICE Gets Colder, and the Blinking Cursor
content:
"Peg, we need a woman's song." "F*** off, I'm doing the accounts." In a delightful Q&A with The Guardian, folk legend Peggy Seeger reflects on her life, music, and activism. Click the link if you're into music history, feminist icons, or just love a good quote.

:emoji: ICE Is Running Out of Space A sobering look at the U.S. immigration system's mounting pressure: detention centers are overflowing, and ICE is turning to small towns and private prisons to manage the surge.

Blink And You'll Miss It How a simple visual cue keeps us oriented in out digital spaces.
author: Brandon Blatcher
